description: Returns one BrainVault v3 card: creator, official, tags, mint block, and its text only when public and the on-chain hash matches (sha256_ok). Private: text null; hidden: hidden true. Use verify_citations to check many refs at once. Read-only, free, no key. Unknown ref: error not_found.
